claims.statement: Management expects European business to reach 15% plus, getting to 22% in Europe with the Nagarro combination.
claims.quote: We add to the European business, we live to our dream of having European business at 15% plus. In fact, it's a very nice combination which gets us to 22% in Europe
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets $5 billion aspiration by FY31.
claims.quote: do we need additional verticals to scale to the aspiration of $5 billion that we have? By FY31, we get that as well at a nice scale.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects net debt over combined EBITDA leverage of 1.9x to 2.5x to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.
claims.quote: The leverage, that is the Net Debt over the combined EBITDA, is going to be 1.9 times-2.5 times based on how much will be the open offer acceptance. So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the transaction to be Cash EPS accretive and Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 excluding transaction expenses.
claims.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses that will be incurred in the first year.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: Cash EPS accretive and Reported EPS accretive

claims.statement: Management expects the transaction to close sometime towards Q4 of Calendar Year 2026 or early Q1 of Calendar Year 2027.
claims.quote: we expect this transaction to close sometime towards the Q4 of Calendar Year 2026 or early Q1 of Calendar Year 2027.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Persistent agreed to acquire 100% of Nagarro shares at an enterprise value of €1.27 billion based on €81 per share in cash.
facts.quote: Persistent has agreed to acquire 100% of the Nagarro shares at an enterprise value of €1.27 billion based on an €81 per share in cash

facts.statement: Persistent secured a 21% stake in Nagarro via share purchase agreement from the major shareholder.
facts.quote: It has already secured 21% stake in Nagarro via share purchase agreement from the major shareholder.

facts.statement: Reported net debt of Nagarro is around €267 million.
facts.quote: Then there is a Net Debt, reported Net Debt, of around €267 million. And that translates into the enterprise value of €1.27 billion.

facts.statement: The transaction is funded through a committed bridge financing from Barclays with an interest rate of Euribor plus a margin of 175-250 basis points.
facts.quote: This will be completely funded through a committed bridge financing from Barclays. The interest rate is going to be Euribor plus a margin of 175-250 basis point.

facts.statement: Goodwill and other intangibles put together are anticipated to be roughly 70% goodwill and 30% other intangibles, amortized over 8 years.
facts.quote: Goodwill and Other Intangibles put together, so we are anticipating it will be roughly around 70% Goodwill and 30% Other Intangibles. And those Other Intangibles will be amortized over a period of 8 years.
